course_name_en: Sales of Technical Products and Systems
prerequisites: Preceding modules that promote basic knowledge and communicative skills in the respective subject area.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can classify the essential sub-areas of sales and their underlying scientific approaches into the technical subject context.
Students who have successfully completed this module have basic knowledge in the field of "Technical Sales" and can explain application possibilities.
Students can reflect on sales methods and concepts with reference to existing technical requirements and conditions.
After successful completion of this module, students apply typical professional methods: identifying requirements and needs, product selection, pricing, formulating an offer, closing a contract.

After passing, students can present themselves / their company / their project / a product, give and receive feedback. They know questioning techniques for conducting conversations and can choose an influencing style appropriate to the situation. They can demonstrate that partnership-based collaboration often leads to intensive exchange with customers.

assessment_rules: The graded examination consists of a written exam and a presentation (with written elaboration). Both parts of the examination are weighted at 50% each and must be passed. The presentation should be approx. 5-10 pages and 20 minutes.
